problem:
For the matrix
$B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 & -3 \\ 1 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 2 & 6\end{aligned}],$
find the minor ${M}_{33}$ of the entry ${b}_{33}.$

${M}_{33}=${{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The minor of ${b}_{33}=6$ (third row, third column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $6$ are removed: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 & ∗ \\ 1 & -1 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & 6\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${b}_{33}=6$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{33} & =\text{det}[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot (-1)-5\cdot 1 \\  & =-2-5 \\  & =-7.\end{aligned}
$$
